svg.title: Task updates and reporting
svg.desc: The same path handles progress, human decisions and outcomes from every earlier flow. Remote confirmation, CLI display, host delivery, AI processing and the public report are distinct records, detailed in the receipt table.

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 1. Tool receives a local change or Linear event

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 2. Is the source authentic and permitted?

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 3. Tool saves and deduplicates the event or operation

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 4. Tool applies guards and confirms Linear facts

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 5. Tool refuses, fences or retains unresolved work

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 6. Tool updates the CLI and delivers the lead event

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 7. Did the lead process this exact event?

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 8. Lead reports; tool records the public receipt

g.data-value: Local and Linear changes, safe handling and separate lead/user receipts.
g.text: Local and Linear changes, safe handling and separate lead/user receipts.
